en-GB.promotionalText: Track every kg of CO₂ avoided. Watch the Live Rescue Wave. Join 50,000+ people preventing 1 million meals from landfill — entirely on your iPhone.
en-GB.description:
YOUR KITCHEN. YOUR CLIMATE. TRACKED.

Food waste accounts for 8–10% of global greenhouse gas emissions. If food waste were a country, it would be the third-largest emitter on Earth — after only the US and China. Freshli puts that fight in your pocket.

LIVE RESCUE WAVE
Watch the world rescue food in real-time. Every item logged by every Freshli user, anywhere on Earth, animates across a global mesh-gradient map. Be part of the wave that hit 1 million rescues — and counting.

MEASURED BY SCIENCE
Freshli's CO₂ figures are sourced from peer-reviewed life-cycle assessments (Poore & Nemecek, 2018; FAO 2024). Not vibes — actual climate science. Every kg of beef saved = 27 kg CO₂e avoided. Every kg of veg = 1.4 kg.

YOUR PERSONAL CLIMATE DASHBOARD
• kg CO₂ avoided this week, month, year
• Litres of water saved (food has a water footprint)
• Land area protected from agricultural conversion
• Compare your impact to: car miles not driven, trees planted, flights cancelled

COMMUNITY FRIDGES
Find community fridges near you. List your surplus for free collection. Find local pods for hyper-local food sharing. Earn karma — climb hero tiers from Seedling to Champion.

WEEKLY IMPACT WRAP
Cinematic Sunday recap of your week: meals saved, kg CO₂ avoided, water reclaimed, money kept. Share to socials in one tap.

FRESHLI+ UNLOCKS
• Unlimited pantry tracking
• Advanced impact analytics with month/year/lifetime views
• Carbon-cost recipe sorting (lowest CO₂ first)
• Live Activities for cooking timers
• Priority support

PRIVACY-FIRST
All computation happens on your iPhone. No food data, no impact data, no usage data ever leaves your device. Anonymous aggregate stats only — opt-in, never required.

NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO COMPROMISE.
Freshli has zero analytics SDKs and zero advertising SDKs. The Privacy Manifest declares zero tracking — verifiable by Apple.

FOR THE PLANET. WITH PROOF.

PRIVACIDAD ABSOLUTA
Todo se procesa en tu iPhone. Cero analíticas, cero anuncios.

POR EL PLANETA. CON PRUEBAS.

科学的測定
FreshliのCO₂数値は査読論文から（Poore & Nemecek, 2018; FAO 2024）。気分ではなく実際の気候科学。

あなたの気候ダッシュボード

プライバシー第一

地球のため。証拠とともに。
